name: Pass 26 production/SRE handoff hardening
goal: Ensure human-owned production handoff, outage drill, runbook replay, and operator readiness proof are executable gates.
risks: Production handoff templates could be mistaken for evidence
Outage drills could remain unsigned or below readiness threshold
Release handoff could omit rollback, observability, incident, support, or training paths

nodes.label: Pass 26 production readiness critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether production/SRE handoff evidence is enforceable.
node_contract.why: The original transcript requires humans to maintain and operate factory outputs safely.
node_contract.how: Inspect df-production-sre-handoff templates, skill instructions, runner coverage, and existing evidence gates.
node_contract.where: df-production-sre-handoff skill and codex-skills validation suite.
node_contract.who: Codex using SRE, human-handoff, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: New findings are reproducible and become validator checks plus negative fixtures.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any missing production proof becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner fixture.

nodes.label: Production handoff validator implementation

node_contract.what: Add executable validation for production handoff and outage drill evidence.
node_contract.why: Operator readiness must be proven by live records, not templates or prose promises.
node_contract.how: Create validate_production_handoff.py, add pass fixtures, add template and low-readiness negative checks, update skill resources and manifest.
node_contract.where: Installed df-production-sre-handoff skill, workspace bundle, and validation fixtures.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Complete production and outage fixtures pass; templates, missing rollback, low readiness, and unsigned drills fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every production/SRE validator change.
gates: production/SRE fixtures pass and reject as expected

nodes.label: Pass 26 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Production/SRE hardening only counts if it survives the same repeated proof loop as other DFMS controls.
node_contract.how: Run the full hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 26 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
